label: Collective action and change
text: MS.O.A5.5 Collective action and change. Social movements that target a norm or an organisation. A movement contesting authority is PO.O.A3.3 (CONTESTED target rule). The free-rider result is EC.O.A5.3. Differentiation, diffusion, globalisation. Named theories of history (Marxian, functionalist) are answer-families, reconstructed under MS.M.3.
